summary: Iteration 2 (multi-tenant + roles + OAuth-framework) tested end-to-end. Backend: 84/84 pytest passed (43 new multi-tenant/roles/OAuth tests + 41 preserved-and-updated iteration-1 tests, run serially with -n 0 to avoid the pro/free plan race between the two files). Verified: fresh-user bootstrap creates own seeded workspace as owner; two isolated users see different workspace_ids; client cannot spoof workspace_id via query param; owner+member share one workspace; invite of existing user auto-joins (auto_joined:true, membership active) and invite of unregistered email creates pending row that activates on first /auth/me; full role-denial matrix (member gets 403 on decisions:act, members:invite, payments/checkout, integrations/*/connect, integrations/toggle, briefing/generate, reports/weekly-pack, demo/reset-plan) and 200 on all 15 read endpoints + tasks PATCH + /ask streaming; owner cannot change/delete self (400); workspaces list/create/switch work incl. 404 on unknown ws; Google/QuickBooks integrations report oauth:true configured:false and /connect returns {configured:false, message}; integrations.can_manage true for owner, false for member; free plan gates briefing/generate + weekly-pack + non-oauth toggle (403); Pro flip via db.workspaces enables real Claude Sonnet 4.6 briefing (>20 chars) and Weekly CEO Pack; Stripe checkout returns url+session_id and payment_transactions row carries workspace_id; ask history is per-(workspace,user) with no cross-user leakage. Frontend (playwright, owner session cookie then member session cookie): workspace-switcher renders name/role/plan and opens dropdown with 'New company' create option; sidebar-nav-members visible; Members page invite form (invite-email-input/invite-role-select/invite-submit-btn) successfully creates a new member row for owner; 6 member rows render; Integrations page shows 'Keys needed' badge + 'OAuth' pill and Set-up click on free-plan owner gracefully routes to /billing via toast + navigate (no crash); Decisions page owner sees 3 approve buttons; MEMBER session correctly hides approve/reject/delegate buttons and shows 'Only workspace owners can act on decisions', hides sidebar-upgrade-btn and Members invite form, still sees workspace-switcher labeled 'member', briefing home loads without errors ('Good morning, Mia.').
critical_code_review_comments: backend/pytest.ini pins -n 2 --dist loadscope but the two test files both mutate the same workspace.plan (pro/free) so parallel runs across workers can race. Manifested when running the whole /app/backend/tests suite: single test file passes, but combined parallel run intermittently flakes on test_pro_plan_enables_briefing_and_weekly and Ask tests. Workaround: run with -n 0. Fix path: give the pro-flipping tests their own scratch workspace (created via POST /api/workspaces) instead of mutating the shared one.

server.py invite_member lower-cases the email before lookup (correct), but there's no whitespace strip on payload.email — a trailing space in the UI input would produce a distinct membership row. Minor UX guard.

server.py CORSMiddleware uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True; the effective behavior is same as allow_origins=['*']+credentials (browsers reject). Only works today because frontend is same-origin via ingress. Iteration_1 already flagged this — still present.

server.py get_principal auto-picks 'any active membership' if the user's active_workspace_id points to a workspace they were removed from — silently reassigns. Fine for demo, but on invite-removal the removed user will silently jump back into their bootstrap workspace with no signal. Consider surfacing this in /auth/me.

server.py oauth_callback trusts state=provider:workspace_id without cryptographic signing — CSRF risk once OAuth keys are added. Recommend signing the state with a short-lived HMAC before enabling live keys.

seed_data.build_workspace names workspace '{first}\'s Company' at bootstrap (fine), but /api/company hardcodes 'Northwind Robotics' template data — every new workspace looks identical to Northwind. Consider randomizing or blanking demo values for non-first workspaces.

Frontend Integrations.jsx: on free-plan owner, clicking 'Set up' for a Keys-needed OAuth card fires gate() which errors + navigates to /billing — but the visual affordance still says 'Set up' rather than 'Requires Pro'. Slight message-vs-action mismatch (works but confusing).
Frontend AppLayout WorkspaceSwitcher uses window.prompt() for new workspace name — jarring UX vs the rest of the polished UI. Consider a modal.

Frontend WorkspaceSwitcher button text renders 'AAlex's Company' (avatar letter + name concatenated in DOM without separator); visually there is a gap because of flex spacing, but text-content extraction shows the concat — no user-visible bug, just a testability note.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite has 84 tests across /app/backend/tests/. IMPORTANT: run with `-n 0` (serial) — the default pytest.ini uses `-n 2 --dist loadscope` but the two files share workspace.plan state and race. Individual files pass with default parallel config. Frontend can be validated by setting cookie session_token=test_session_kalun_123 (owner) or test_session_user2 (member) on the preview host and hitting /, /members, /decisions, /integrations. Google/QuickBooks OAuth intentionally report configured:false — do NOT treat as a bug. To exercise Pro-gated endpoints, flip mongo `db.workspaces.updateOne({workspace_id:'<id>'},{$set:{plan:'pro'}})` (get workspace_id from /api/auth/me) and reset via POST /api/demo/reset-plan.
rca of the issue: No functional bugs. Three initial test failures were self-inflicted test issues: (a) pydantic EmailStr rejects the '.test' reserved TLD → switched invited emails to '@example.com'; (b) backend lowercases email but I seeded mixed-case Test_* emails → made test emails all-lowercase to match the lookup; (c) parallel xdist run flaked pro/free plan tests → confirmed all pass under `-n 0`.
